front: When did the UN come into existence?
back: 24 October 1945, when the Charter (signed 26 June 1945 at San Francisco) came into force.

front: Name the five permanent members of the Security Council.
back: USA, Britain, France, Russia (formerly the USSR) and China.
The power of each permanent member to block a Security Council decision.

front: Name the six principal organs of the UN.
back: General Assembly, Security Council, Secretariat, International Court of Justice, Economic and Social Council, Trusteeship Council.

front: When was the Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted?
When did Zimbabwe join the UN?
Give three UN peace successes and two failures.
back: Successes: Korea (1950-53), Suez (1956), Namibia (1989-90). Failures: Rwanda (1994), Srebrenica (1995).

front: What were the UN's first mandatory economic sanctions?
back: Sanctions against Rhodesia after UDI, imposed in 1966 and widened in 1968.
An organisation linked to the UN working in one field, e.g. WHO (health), FAO (food), ILO (labour), UNESCO (education and culture).
